name: control-tower
description: Universal Chief-of-Staff Control Tower plugin for Antigravity: hidden-surface-first dispatch, 4-surface navigator, zero-token sentinel + Focus Gate inbox, isolation & collaboration contracts, 3-tier project roadmap DAG, and Aux Pane board.
author: Hi-Jiajun
suggestedPrompts: 启用 control-tower 总控规程，对当前工作区执行纯只读冷启动盘点并初始化或核对 SESSION-REGISTRY.md。
按 control-tower 规范评估新需求：通过 ask_question 推荐调度通道（原生 swarm / agentapi 直派 / 手动兜底）并完成模型路由与派单入账。
按 control-tower 换届规程同步最新会话台账与生效设置，生成交接卡或准备总控接班。
